name: David McKenna
bio: David McKenna is known for Lord of the Flies (2026).

credits.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
credits.overview: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

credits.title: Making of Lord of the Flies
credits.overview: A trippy tale capturing the creative vision of writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden, as a British crew and young cast film this timely adaptation on the remote islands of Malaysia during monsoon season.
